long_biography.plain_text:
João Miguel Cunha de Brito Vargas has jointly managed Hinterthal Development's Alpine property interests since 2009. The Austrian company owns real-estate assets and holds a stake in Clubhotel Hinterthal, while Vargas signs its annual accounts with a co-director. Its shareholder, Lusitanahof, also participates in local property management and room-rental businesses.

Vargas's corporate roles extend beyond Austria. He once held a majority interest in a Lisbon design and communications consultancy, and later served as a director of a Luxembourg investment company. Those positions combine representation, financial reporting and board-level administration across privately held businesses in Portugal, Austria and Luxembourg.
